buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Drilling Sub Div Ahmedabad Vehicle Pool Compound B/H Government Polytechnic Gulbai Tekra Pin-380015 . 3. Service, government records or belongings of the officers/employees as well as to the government. 7. The office will decide the working hours 8. Bidder turnover criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover or actual production of the bid der/ during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be at least twi ce the bid value. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the financial turnover or actual production details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / i ncorporation of the bidder is less than 3-year-old, the average financial turnover or actual production in res pect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this crite rion. This will also be applicable for procurement through GeM. 9. Jurisdiction for any kind of Legal matters shall be the Ahmedabad District. 10. Payment of Minimum Wages to Outsourcing Staff 1. 1.The Contractor/Service Provider shall ensure that the minimum wages payable to each Outsourcin g Staff deployed under this contract, as prescribed by the applicable Minimum Wages Act and notifi cations issued by the Government of Gujarat from time to time, are paid directly into the respective Outsourcing Staff's bank account through digital mode (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS or any other authorized ba nking channel). 2. 2.The monthly wages shall be credited to the respective Outsourcing Staff's bank account on or bef ore the 7th day of every succeeding month, without fail. 3. 3.The Contractor/Service Provider shall be solely responsible for timely payment of wages to the de ployed Outsourcing Staff, irrespective of whether the payment of bills submitted by the Contractor/S ervice Provider has been released or withheld by the Government Department due to non-availabilit y of grants/funds, administrative reasons, procedural delays, or any other circumstances. 4. 4.Delay or non-release of payment by the Government Department shall not be considered a valid ground or excuse for withholding, delaying, or reducing the wages payable to the deployed drivers. 5. 5.The Contractor/Service Provider shall submit documentary proof of monthly wage disbursement, i ncluding bank transaction details, wage registers, and other relevant records, to the Engineer-in-Ch arge/concerned authority whenever required. 6. 6.Any violation of the above conditions shall be treated as a breach of contractual obligations and m ay attract appropriate action as per the terms and conditions of the contract, including recovery, pe nalties, or other actions permissible under applicable rules and regulations. .
